geometry.pattern: long route metadata forced the card past the 320 px viewport
geometry.cause: Grid children retained their min-content width and long route labels could not wrap.
geometry.avdsContract: AVDS compact cards must remain within the viewport and preserve readable source identifiers.
geometry.fix: Allowed grid children and metadata to shrink, wrapped long identifiers, and let the card header wrap at compact widths.

typography.pattern: the Swagger version badge rendered below the required text contrast
typography.cause: Swagger's badge background inherited a muted combination outside the product token contract.
typography.avdsContract: AVDS text and metadata must retain WCAG AA contrast on product surfaces.
typography.fix: Applied the opaque surface, text, and border tokens to Swagger version metadata.
